critical_code_review_comments: Iteration_8 RCA confirmed correct: removing `style={{ contain: 'layout paint' }}` from <main> in Layout.jsx (line 48) was the right fix. The selection-bar's offsetParent is now null (i.e. the viewport) and main.contain computes as 'none'.
Biblia.jsx is still ~1187 lines. Splitting SelectionBar / StudyPanel / ShareCard into separate files remains a useful refactor (carried over from iteration_8).

isMobile detection still uses window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)') in Biblia.jsx and AITutorDrawer.jsx, so the mobile-only branches (study-mobile-modal, ai-tutor-mobile-modal, paddingTop:70px) cannot be exercised by automated Playwright Chromium. Combining with viewport width (e.g. (max-width:1023px)) would make these branches QA-testable.

On /biblia (desktop and mobile), the selection-tutor-ia button opens the bottom Drawer focused on AI block; it does not mount the AITutorDrawer component (AITutorDrawer is only on /aula/{id}). That matches the iteration_8 note and is not a bug, just a clarification for the review request wording.

rca of the issue: Resolved. Iteration_8 root cause: `style={{ contain: 'layout paint' }}` on <main> made <main> a containing block for position:fixed descendants (W3C CSS Containment), pushing the selection-bar ~3500px below the viewport. Fix in iteration_9: that style was removed from <main> in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx. Verified at runtime: getComputedStyle(main).contain === 'none', selection-bar offsetParent === null, getBoundingClientRect.y is ~654 on 1440x900 and ~669 on 412x915 — both inside the visible viewport. Bar is now visible and usable to end users.
